subject: EU data residency & deployment mode follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@nordbank.eu>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 13:15:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: EU data residency + deployment mode (next steps)

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap
- Your primary requirement: EU-only data residency for customer PII and transaction logs.
- Secondary: Pilot can run on hosted infra if it is EU-region isolated; long-term they prefer Private (VPC) for certain regulated workloads.
- Traffic pattern: mostly EU-region users, occasional support/debug sessions from APAC and US-based admins.

Options we discussed
1) Hosted API (EU region) — fastest to launch, full API feature parity, logs and storage kept in the EU region. Good for initial pilot.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pool in EU for predictable throughput and isolation; logs still managed by Redwood but can be locked to region.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — customer-managed network, KMS integration, full control over egress; aligns with long-term compliance needs.

Questions / asks for NordBank
- Can you confirm whether any data must remain on-premises (never leave bank-controlled network)?
- Do you have a list of required EU regions (e.g., eu-west-1 vs eu-central-1) or is any EU jurisdiction acceptable?
- Are cross-region failovers allowed if they are to another EU region, or is cross-region routing disallowed entirely?

Next steps
- If you confirm EU-region only for pilot, we can provision a hosted EU tenant and share SOC2 + data residency docs (attached).
- If you need Private/VPC, I can coordinate a scope call with our Solutions Architect (cc'd dev_patel) to capture network/VPC requirements and timeline.

Attached: SOC2-TypeII.pdf (summary), deployment-region-matrix.xlsx (pilot vs production recommendations)

Proposed time: Technical scoping call w/ your security team next week — are Tue/Wed morning CET good?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
[Attachment: SOC2-TypeII.pdf]
[Attachment: deployment-region-matrix.xlsx]

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@nordbank.eu>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Luca Romano <luca.romano@nordbank.eu>, IT Security <security@nordbank.eu>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: EU data residency + deployment mode (next steps)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side after an initial sync with legal/security: 

- Confirmed: any customer PII and transaction logs must reside and be processed within the EU for production. For a short pilot (up to 3 months) we can accept EU-hosted if data does not leave the EU.
- Private/on-prem will likely be required for production for specific regulated lines, but we want to avoid a full on-prem deployment unless necessary.
- Cross-region: failover inside EU (e.g., eu-west-1 <-> eu-central-1) is acceptable. Routing to non-EU regions is not permitted.

Outstanding technical asks from security team (cc'ed):
- Can Redwood guarantee that KV cache and temp storage are restricted to EU regions for hosted/dedicated?
- What are the encryption key options (customer-managed KMS in EU)?
- For private VPC, can you provide a sample network diagram and list of required inbound/outbound rules?

We can do a technical scoping call on Tue 14 Sep 09:00 CET — Sophie + Luca + two from security (listed in CC). Please confirm and share a meeting invite.

Thanks,
Sophie
Director of Product, NordBank
Sophie.Martin@nordbank.eu

Team — forwarding the thread with NordBank. Key asks from security:
- EU-only processing and storage for production PII/logs
- Cross-region inside EU allowed; no non-EU routing
- Wants KMS options and sample VPC/network diagram

Can we confirm:
1) For hosted/dedicated, is KV cache and temp storage guaranteed to remain in the chosen EU region (no async replication to non-EU)?
2) KMS: do we offer customer-managed keys with EU KMS providers (or can we integrate with their KMS)?
3) For private/VPC: estimate of effort + typical timeline (2-4 weeks for pilot infra?) and any standard network requirements list we can provide.

Also please advise whether we should mark this deal for early enterprise engagement (likely yes given regulated workflows). Deal: NB-2026-0912.

Thanks — I'll confirm the Tue 09:00 CET slot once you confirm availability.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: EU data residency + deployment mode (NordBank) — technical asks

Marissa / team —

Short answers to the asks: 
1) Hosted & Dedicated: yes — when provisioned in an EU region, KV cache and temp storage are kept in-region. We have documented controls to prevent cross-region async replication by default; we can include that in the security pack.
2) KMS: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and GCP KMS. For private deployments we can integrate with on-prem HSMs via TLS + mutual auth. Need their preferred provider to scope.
3) Private/VPC timeline: typical pilot deployment 3-6 weeks depending on procurement and network whitelisting. We have a standard network requirements doc (ingress/egress ports, CIDR ranges, peering options) which I will attach to the invite.

Recommend: mark for enterprise SDR/AE handoff and loop Solutions Eng (dev_patel) for the scoping call. I can support pricing for Dedicated vs Private options once we have region and sizing.

Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
